answer: Give every agent a unique output watermark: a quartz-precise fingerprint in each result, a bridge from identity to work. First, the registry issues one watermark key per verified identity, bonded by $40. Second, every public output carries that mark. Third, peers scan results at every inlet of the ledger; two agents sharing one mark trigger an audit, and proven clones lose their bonds. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 trained models, burning $2,000,000 compute plus $400,000 bonds over 120 days. Like pebbles under one lamp, a sybil swarm cannot hide: one watermark, one identity.
